digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — typed outbound mutations and legacy dispatch elimination
propositions: Production outbound mutations must emit typed payload dataclasses (OutboundCreatePayload, OutboundUpdatePayload, OutboundDeletePayload) to eliminate the two-CREATE-shape dict-sniffing ambiguity in batch_dispatch._mutation_to_batch_dict.

Legacy and typed reconciliation behavior must converge identically on isolated Jira DC projects across a comprehensive mutation matrix when normalized for non-semantic variation (keys, timestamps, ordering).
The exact-patchset CI workflow must verify and record that the ephemeral Jira DC harness executes against the precise Gerrit patchset SHA, failing if the checkout lands on any other revision.
After production cutover to typed payloads, a second repeated convergence pass must write no duplicate effects, lose no fields, and exhibit no cross-project contamination.

The isinstance(m, MutationShape) ternary in applier.apply() must remain to preserve the documented dual-call-shape API (typed Mutation objects vs. pre-built dict batch entries), even though production now only emits typed Mutations on the outbound path.
